source_caption:
Dead Ant (2017) is a hilarious horror-comedy about a once-famous 80s glam-metal band, Sonic Grave, attempting a comeback at Coachella. Things take a wild turn when they face giant killer ants in the desert. 

The fictional band, Sonic Grave, was inspired by real 80s rock legends, with costumes and antics designed to capture their over-the-top lifestyle. Plus, many desert scenes were shot with a blend of practical effects and modern VFX to create those giant ant mayhem moments. 

Keep an eye out for Sydney Sweeney’s cheeky “Nice to finally meet you, Daddy!” line it’s a fan-favorite that adds to the film’s playful vibe.

source_details.synopsis: Dead Ant (also titled Giant Killer Ants) is a 2017 American comedy horror film directed by Ron Carlson, starring Tom Arnold, Sean Astin, Rhys Coiro, Jake Busey, and Leisha Hailey.
